bankr prompt "Using the tollex skill, is TSLA halted right now?"

# Multiplier-adjusted Stock Token price (~$0.008)

# Simulate a Robinhood Chain transaction before signing it (~$0.008)
bankr prompt "Using the tollex skill, simulate this call before I send it: to 0x5fc5360D0400a0Fd4f2af552ADD042D716F1d168 data 0x18160ddd"

# What does an x402 endpoint charge, and who gets paid? (~$0.008)
bankr prompt "Using the tollex skill, inspect https://api.tollex.org/v1/agent-check"

setup: No install and no account: plain HTTPS endpoints behind x402 v2
Pays in USDC on Base or USDG on Robinhood Chain, about $0.008 per call (the live 402 states the exact price)
Set a cap on every call: bankr x402 call ... --max-payment 0.02
Free planning and catalog: POST https://api.tollex.org/v1/resolve, GET https://api.tollex.org/v1/catalog
Each paid result returns an EIP-712 signed receipt in the PAYMENT-RESPONSE header; keys at https://api.tollex.org/.well-known/tollex-receipt-keys
